description: The bar chart presents the number of datasets categorized as "Untargeted" and "Targeted" over the years from 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the years, while the vertical axis indicates the number of datasets, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160. Each year is represented by a pair of bars, with the "Untargeted" datasets shown in blue and the "Targeted" datasets in orange. The chart shows a general increase in the number of both "Untargeted" and "Targeted" datasets over the years, with the "Targeted" datasets consistently outnumbering the "Untargeted" ones. The tallest bars are observed in 2021, with the "Targeted" datasets reaching approximately 140 and the "Untargeted" datasets around 20. The shortest bars are seen in 2012, with both categories having a value close to 0. The chart does not provide any additional annotations or emphasis on specific bars.
